_comment: Risk classification for this deployment's own tools (REMORA_TOOL_METADATA_FILE). REMORA's TOOL_REGISTRY classifies six names; without this file every tool below would fall to the fail-closed floor of critical/unknown and no read could ever be ACCEPTed. The declaration is additive only — a name REMORA already classifies is refused here — and its resolved content is hashed into REMORA's policy bundle identity, so editing this file invalidates every execution lease issued under the old classification. Changing a tier is a policy change, not a config tweak.
_medium_tier_note: create_work_order is declared high because a fully grounded MEDIUM-risk write matches no rule in REMORA 0.10.0: it falls through to default_safe_abstain with no review item and no ResolutionPlan, so an operator never sees it. At high it reaches the review queue with a named required_role, which is where a human can at least see it. It lands on ESCALATE rather than VERIFY because rollback_available is false, and that is truthful: no deployed tool removes a work order, so creating one cannot be undone. Note that an approved ESCALATE still cannot execute in 0.10.0 - see docs/limitations.md. The classification is honest; the remaining dead end is upstream.
